title: Amir Temur (Tamerlane) — The Undefeated Strategist of Samarkand #Shorts
description:
Timur (1336–1405), known in Central Asia as Amir Temur (Sahibqiron), rose from minor noble origins near Kesh (modern Shahrisabz, Uzbekistan) to found the Timurid Empire. Never defeated on the battlefield, he united Central Asia, Persia, and parts of India and Anatolia. He transformed his capital, Samarkand, into the dazzling pearl of the Silk Road by bringing the world's finest architects, astronomers, and artisans to build monumental masterpieces like the Bibi-Khanym Mosque and Gur-e-Amir, igniting the Timurid Renaissance.
